dogecoin.text:
I sit just under 300 #dogecoin with and average purchase price of $.15

At one point I sat just under 700 $Doge with an average purchase price of $.07

I feel so weak knowing I paper handed this shit when I should've diamond handed it like I had been.

Dearest $doge,

Can we get back to $.70 please

Just sold all my $doge, not because I don't believe in it, but because it had grown so much that I was able to pay for much of my trip this weekend.
Come Monday I plan to buy back in and really get to looking at other cryptos as well. Doge has been awesome, however, so I'm loyal
